images.prompt: Create exactly ONE square 1024x1024 three-dimensional AgntiaPro workflow-node artwork. Art direction: exquisite sculptural industrial product photography in the same family as the approved Apps icons: warm ivory satin ceramic, deep sophisticated violet enamel, restrained brushed champagne brass, seamless soft lavender studio background (#F0ECFC). The object must feel manufactured, tactile and refined, not an extruded flat glyph. Use broad continuous surfaces, believable wall thickness, carefully rounded bevels, subtle material-specific reflections and soft contact shadow. Keep ivory warm rather than white, violet visibly saturated on selected surfaces rather than washed-out pastel, brass a fine accent rather than dominant gold. Background is a continuous lavender cyclorama, softly shaded darker behind the upper object and lighter below, no horizon line or visible tile. Camera: near-frontal three-quarter product view, modest elevation, long-lens-like perspective, consistent scale; broad softbox upper left, gentle right fill, delicate occlusion in recesses. Center the complete object and shadow within a 76% diameter safe circle; dominant object span approximately 62–68% of canvas, with generous negative space and optical centering. The final UI applies the circular crop; do not draw a circular frame or ports. Prioritize a strong silhouette and contrast at 48–96px. No typography, numerals, logos, watermarks, UI, graph edges, pedestal, decorative particles, excessive gloss, toy clay or multiple unrelated objects. Subject: Receiving webhook: a monolithic upright ivory ceramic docking arch, like a refined architectural doorway with a deep violet enamel concave interior. A short thick satin-brass arrow enters diagonally from upper left and ends visibly inside the cavity. The arch has a broad flat foot and rounded shoulders, not a horseshoe magnet. Show the inner wall thickness and a soft violet reflection on the ivory lip. Keep arrow and arch as one tightly grouped composition; no external cables. The dark open cavity is the dominant feature.
